name: team_planning_capacity
description: Get the capacity of a scenario of a Team Planning plan the caller is in. Each person and open position is a seat; each place it holds (a unit and its share of the seat) is priced by the capacity model its role chooses, through the capacity_model planning rule (a role's choice beats its family's). A person's role and level come from their title and level on the map; a position's from the position. Each figure carries its working. Totals are per model, per unit and for the scenario, never summed across models. A place no model covers counts nowhere and is listed in `unclassified` with its reason. Figures are decimal strings. People are named by id, and `names` maps each to a name. Refused, as an unknown plan, unless the caller is a member.

scenario_id.description: The scenario, or the plan's id for the baseline.
